invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter must not be null since it is used to identify the commit or operation in the Hoodie table operations.

meta.value: instantTime is required for operation tracking and commit

invariants.rationale: The list of records to be bulk inserted should not be null, as the method operates directly on this list.

meta.value: hoodieRecords is the main data payload; method cannot work with null

invariants.rationale: context must be non-null since it is downcast and passed to the executor and underpins the operation.

meta.value: context is required for execution engine abstraction
